author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
We kick off this year's product coverage with a review of the new XREAL 1S display glasses, along with the Neo battery dock that allows these glasses to work with Nintendo's Switch and Switch 2 consoles. Here's how this soft refresh of last year's One fits in the lineup, and why it's the last piece of the puzzle culminating in XREAL's Project Aura Android XR glasses coming out later this year. 

XREAL 1S: https://amzn.to/4qufXia
XREAL Neo: https://us.shop.xreal.com/products/xreal-neo
XREAL Eye: https://amzn.to/45G2xXO
XREAL One Pro review: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9TnBpCnX31c
Disclosure: This product was sent to us by the manufacturer for purposes of review. 

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
